title: pieris japonica var. variegata
intro: Pieris japonica var. variegata, commonly known as Japanese Andromeda or Variegated Lilyturf, is a flowering evergreen shrub native to Japan and parts of Asia, characterized by its white, bell-shaped flowers and attractive, variegated foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pieris japonica var. variegata include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality, while also exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
